message: The rescue turns an error into nil, so a failure looks like a missing value. Rescue a named error class and handle it, or let the error propagate.
A missing key reads as an empty value, so fetch no longer raises KeyError for it. Call fetch without a default, so a missing key raises.
A nil or false value reads as an empty container, so a renamed or removed field looks like no data. Check for the missing value in the parse step and raise there.
